title: Antikythera Gears
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Apply tooth-count ratios to three simplified gear trains for Sun, Moon, and Mars cycles.

learningObjectives: Calculate output turns from tooth counts and test the calculation by changing the time input.

keyQuestions: How many output turns follow one input turn?
Why do the Moon ratios multiply?
commonMisconceptions: Gear rotation direction is not sky motion.
Lunar circuits are not lunar phase cycles.
The gear counts are illustrative, not historical.
assessmentOpportunities: Calculate the output of a 48-tooth Mars driver.

limitations: No sky positions, phases, eclipses, or retrograde motion
